concepts.label: Index Partitioning (FTS)
concepts.note: No prior registry term; divides and spreads a large FTS index across multiple nodes to increase query performance.

relations.subject: fts:index-partitioning
relations.evidence: This feature is available only in Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition.

relations.subject: fts:index-partitioning

notable_absence.finding: No privilege documented for setting the number of index partitions, despite the edition restriction being explicit - same privilege-documentation gap as other fts/ pages in this batch.

competency_questions_addressed: Which Couchbase Server edition is required to use Index Partitioning?
What is the default number of index partitions, and where is the partition count stored?
